# Compatibility fixture

`phase2.save` was produced by the actual Phase 2 encoder before Phase 3 source
changes, using the implementation at commit f98914d. It is a genuine schema-1,
generator-2 expedition, seed 42: emergency cache claimed, all three starter
nodes fully mined, tool/kit crafted, shelter built and powered, 350 active ticks
and 31 sheltered night ticks, then a scan. Inventory, fog, discoveries and
structures are retained in the file. The fixture is not generated by relabelling
a Phase 3 save. Migration tests compare original terrain, important progress,
continuation to dawn, schema-2 roundtrip and exact pre-upgrade backup bytes
(including a CRLF copy to cover alternate line endings).
